name: orillacart-scripts
description: Highlighting, checks as you type, completion, hover and a debugger that steps through recorded runs, forwards and backwards, for OrillaCart extension scripts (.ocs), against the shop they will run on.

orillacart.siteUrl.description: The shop's address, such as https://shop.example. Scripts are checked against this site's functions.

orillacart.apiKey.description: An API key from Shop › Integrations (oc_…), acting as the manager who made it. Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

commands.title: OrillaCart: Pull an extension's files from the site
OrillaCart: Push this folder to the site as an extension
OrillaCart: Check the open scripts now
OrillaCart: Run this extension's tests on the site

folder.description: The extension's folder, named after its id. Default: the extension folder of the open .ocs script.

test.description: A test's name: runs it on the shop over this folder's files (the saved files with a read-only key) and steps through its recording.

function.description: A top-level function: runs it on the shop over the extension's saved files and steps through its recording.

recording.description: A recording the shop keeps (from a debugged test, the console or a live capture), by id.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the run's first line; otherwise go to the first breakpoint.

configurationSnippets.label: OrillaCart: Debug a test
configurationSnippets.description: Runs one of the extension's tests on the shop and steps through it.

configurationSnippets.label: OrillaCart: Debug a function
configurationSnippets.description: Runs a function of the extension on the shop and steps through it.

configurationSnippets.label: OrillaCart: Debug a recording
configurationSnippets.description: Steps through a recording the shop keeps, such as a captured live run.
